title: Problems
intro: Everything wrong right now: switches offline, services down, security findings and power circuits close to tripping. Mute a switch you are working on so it stops paging.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.text: Ports to look at, newest first: flapping links, errors rising, half duplex, seats online without a check-in, and syslog lines like err-disable or DHCP snooping. They clear on their own once the port behaves.

quiet: Quiet hours: Discord messages go out silently, without the mention.
muteText: No Discord messages about this switch going offline or coming back until the mute ends. It stays on this list.
